doc_title: DHA Suffa University Company Overview
text:
DHA Suffa University Company Overview — About DSU
## About DSU
DHA Suffa University (DSU) is a private university in Karachi, Pakistan. DSU was established in 2012. DSU has three faculties: the Faculty of Engineering, the Faculty of Computing, and the Faculty of Management Sciences. DSU currently has about 2,400 enrolled students. DSU runs two regular semesters every year: Fall and Spring. Each semester has 16 teaching weeks followed by final examinations.

## Purpose of the DSU Knowledge Assistant
The DSU Knowledge Assistant helps current students, applicants, and parents find information about DSU programs, fees, policies, and campus services. It answers only from official DSU documents and shows the source of every answer.

doc_title: DHA Suffa University Company Overview

DHA Suffa University Company Overview — Campus Location
## Campus Location
DSU has one campus: the DSU Main Campus, located at Phase VII Extension, DHA, Karachi 75500, Pakistan. DSU has no branch campuses.

doc_title: DHA Suffa University Company Overview
text:
DHA Suffa University Company Overview — Office Opening Hours
## Office Opening Hours
General rule: DSU administrative offices (the Registrar's Office, Finance Office, and Student Affairs) are open Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM. They are closed on Saturday, Sunday, and public holidays.

Exception: The DSU Admissions Office is open Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. During the admission season, 1 June to 31 July, the Admissions Office is also open on Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

doc_title: DHA Suffa University Company Overview
text:
DHA Suffa University Company Overview — Library Hours and Fines
## Library Hours and Fines
The DSU Library is open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and on Saturday, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. The library is closed on Sunday.

Exception: During final examination weeks, the DSU Library stays open until 12:00 midnight on weekdays.

The DSU Library fine for an overdue book is Rs. 20 per day per book.

DSU Programs, Fees and Student Services — Common One-Time Fees
## Common One-Time Fees
These fees apply to all DSU programs. The application fee is Rs. 3,000 and is non-refundable. The admission fee is Rs. 25,000, is paid once at admission, and is non-refundable. The security deposit is Rs. 15,000 and is refundable.

doc_title: DSU Programs, Fees and Student Services
text:
DSU Programs, Fees and Student Services — Service: Merit Scholarship
## Service: Merit Scholarship
DSU gives a Merit Scholarship to undergraduate applicants who score 85% or more in the DSU Admission Test. The scholarship waives 50% of tuition. A student keeps the scholarship in later semesters only if their semester GPA is at least 3.50.

doc_title: DSU Programs, Fees and Student Services
text:
DSU Programs, Fees and Student Services — Service: Hardship Fund
## Service: Hardship Fund
The DSU Hardship Fund is need-based financial aid. After a committee review, it waives between 25% and 100% of tuition. The application deadline is 31 August for Fall semesters and 10 January for Spring semesters. Hardship Fund recipients receive special late-fee treatment, described in the current Student Academic and Fee Policy.

doc_title: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy
text:
DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy — DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy - Version 3.0 (CURRENT)
# DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy - Version 3.0 (CURRENT)

Version 3.0 is the current policy. It applies to all DSU semesters starting on or after 1 August 2026, including Fall 2026. It replaces version 2.1, which is archived.

doc_title: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy
text:
DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy — 3.1 Attendance
## 3.1 Attendance
> Policy: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy | Version 3.0 | Status: CURRENT | Effective: 1 August 2026

General rule: A DSU student must attend at least 75% of classes in every course to be allowed to sit the final examination. A student below 75% is not allowed to sit the final examination and receives an F in that course.

Exception: For laboratory courses and laboratory components, the minimum attendance is 85%.

An absence supported by a medical certificate is excused and not counted as an absence, if the certificate is submitted to Student Affairs within 5 working days.

doc_title: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy
text:
DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy — 3.2 Add and Drop of Courses
## 3.2 Add and Drop of Courses
> Policy: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy | Version 3.0 | Status: CURRENT | Effective: 1 August 2026

A DSU student may add or drop courses without penalty during the first 10 calendar days of a semester. After day 10, courses cannot be added, and dropping a course requires written approval from the Head of Department.

doc_title: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy
text:
DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy — 3.3 Tuition Payment and Late Fee
## 3.3 Tuition Payment and Late Fee
> Policy: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy | Version 3.0 | Status: CURRENT | Effective: 1 August 2026

Semester tuition must be paid by the due date announced by the Finance Office. The late fee is Rs. 3,000 for each week, or part of a week, of delay. The maximum late fee is Rs. 12,000. If tuition remains unpaid after 4 weeks, course registration is cancelled.

Exception: A student who receives the Hardship Fund pays no late fee if tuition is paid within 14 days of the due date.

doc_title: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy
text:
DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy — 3.4 Withdrawal and Refunds
## 3.4 Withdrawal and Refunds
> Policy: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy | Version 3.0 | Status: CURRENT | Effective: 1 August 2026

When a student withdraws from DSU, the tuition refund depends on the timing:
- Before the first day of classes: 100% refund.
- During weeks 1 and 2: 75% refund.
- During weeks 3 and 4: 50% refund.
- After the end of week 4: no refund.

The application fee and admission fee are never refunded. The refundable security deposit is returned within 30 days after the student completes clearance.

doc_title: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy
text:
DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy — 3.5 Academic Probation
## 3.5 Academic Probation
> Policy: DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy | Version 3.0 | Status: CURRENT | Effective: 1 August 2026

A DSU student whose CGPA falls below 2.00 at the end of a semester is placed on academic probation for the next semester. A student on academic probation may register for at most 12 credit hours.

# DSU Student Academic and Fee Policy - Version 2.1 (ARCHIVED)

Version 2.1 is an old policy. It applied to DSU semesters that started between 1 January 2023 and 31 July 2026. It was replaced by version 3.0 on 1 August 2026 and is not valid for Fall 2026 or later. Use this document only for questions about old or historical rules.

# DHA Suffa University (DSU) - Operations, Procedures and FAQs

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — Admission Procedure
## Admission Procedure
DSU admission has four steps. Step 1: submit the online application and pay the application fee. Step 2: sit the DSU Admission Test, which has 100 marks and lasts 90 minutes. The passing mark is 50. Step 3: DSU publishes the merit list within 7 working days of the test. Step 4: admitted candidates pay the admission fee and first-semester tuition within 10 calendar days of the offer letter.

Required documents: a copy of the CNIC or B-form, matric and intermediate transcripts, and 4 passport-size photographs.

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — Transfer Students
## Transfer Students
DSU accepts transfer students from HEC-recognized universities. DSU transfers credit for up to 40% of the program's credit hours, and only for courses in which the student earned grade B or better.

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — Fee Payment Procedure
## Fee Payment Procedure
A DSU student can pay fees through the DSU Student Portal by debit or credit card or by bank transfer, or with a challan at a partner bank branch. The Finance Office does not accept cash. The fee receipt appears in the Student Portal within 2 working days of payment.

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — Course Registration
## Course Registration
DSU students register for courses through the Student Portal during registration week. The maximum credit load is 18 credit hours per semester.

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — Examinations and Results
## Examinations and Results
DSU publishes final results on the Student Portal within 14 working days after the last examination. A student may apply for a recheck within 7 days of the results. The recheck fee is Rs. 1,500 per course. The fee is refunded if the marks change.

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — Student ID Cards
## Student ID Cards
A replacement DSU student ID card costs Rs. 1,000 and is ready in 3 working days. A student who loses an ID card must report the loss to Student Affairs.

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — IT Helpdesk and Passwords
## IT Helpdesk and Passwords
A DSU student can reset a Student Portal password using the Forgot Password link or by visiting the IT Helpdesk, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. DSU staff never ask for a password by email or chat.

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — Library Borrowing
## Library Borrowing
An undergraduate student can borrow 5 books for 14 days. A graduate student (MSCS or EMBA) can borrow 8 books for 21 days.

doc_title: DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs
text:
DSU Operations, Procedures and FAQs — Frequently Asked Questions
## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Can I pay my tuition in installments?**
A: No. DSU tuition is payable in full for each semester. Students who need financial help can apply to the Hardship Fund.

**Q: Does DSU hold classes on Saturdays?**
A: No. Undergraduate and MS classes run Monday to Friday. Executive MBA classes run Monday to Thursday evenings.

**Q: How do I get an official transcript?**
A: Apply at the Registrar's Office. An official transcript costs Rs. 800 per copy and is ready in 5 working days.

**Q: Whom do I contact about medical leave?**
A: Submit the medical certificate to Student Affairs. The deadline is stated in the current Student Academic and Fee Policy.

**Q: What is the library fine for an overdue book?**
A: The DSU Library fine is Rs. 25 per day per book.
